stage: CGT-PAPER13 P4 paper ablations (RUN AFTER P2 frozen, per objective section 22)

ablation_A_rank.finding: The frozen F0 fused CUDA kernel (f0_kernels.so) correctly supports ONLY R=4. Running the SAME kernel with R=8/R=16 produces catastrophic kernel-correctness failure (fused vs where(safe,student,teacher) reference max_abs ~0.86 >> 2e-5 gate). The kernel's coeffs stride / student-mixture loop is compiled for R=4; passing a larger R mis-reads the coeffs buffer. Therefore the rank ablation CANNOT be validly run with the frozen kernel.
ablation_A_rank.interpretation: R=4 is the only valid rank for the frozen kernel. Upstream G1 CPU rank evidence (R=4/8/16) does not transfer to the fused CUDA kernel without a kernel rebuild (forbidden in PAPER13).
ablation_A_rank.decision: Do NOT replace frozen rank. R=4 remains the only production-valid rank.

ablation_B_cert_fallback.finding: Certified mixed path is necessary: safe tiles (mean 61.7%) use the student fast path; unsafe tiles (mean weighted fallback 45.1%) REQUIRE teacher fallback for correctness. A no-fallback student-only variant would render unsafe tiles incorrectly (student approx error up to cert GATE=0.02, unbounded on hard tiles). Full runtime no-fallback ablation NOT_REACHED (E2E failure in P3 makes production ablation moot).
